# Sunset & Sail Travel

> Full-service vacation packaging: we bundle round-trip airfare, pre-cruise hotels, port transfers, car rentals, and destination tickets into one all-inclusive quote. Serving U.S. and Canadian travelers; personal service with a real travel advisor on every booking. Typical reply time: within 1 business day.

## Bundle Packages
- **7-Night Western Caribbean Cruise Bundle**: Round-trip flights, pre-cruise hotel, 7-night cruise to Cozumel, Grand Cayman & Jamaica, rental car, two shore excursions, travel insurance. Budget range: $1,500–$2,500/person (Economy). (https://www.sunsetsailtravel.example/#bundles)
- **10-Night Alaska Glacier Cruise Bundle**: Flights to Seattle, hotel night, glacier itinerary, city tour, attraction day pass, travel insurance. Budget range: $2,500–$4,000/person (Premium). (https://www.sunsetsailtravel.example/#bundles)
- **12-Night Mediterranean Grand Tour Bundle**: Flights to Barcelona, 2 hotel nights, 12-night cruise, rail pass, skip-the-line tickets, travel insurance. Budget range: $4,000+/person (Luxury). (https://www.sunsetsailtravel.example/#bundles)

## How It Works
- Consultation: Share dates, budget, departure city, and must-see ports. (https://www.sunsetsailtravel.example/#process)
- Packaging: One consolidated quote covering air, cabin, hotel, transfers, car, and tickets. (https://www.sunsetsailtravel.example/#process)
- Approval & support: Single payment schedule, price-drop monitoring, delay protection guidance. (https://www.sunsetsailtravel.example/#process)

## Policies & Practical Info
- Pricing: Budget tiers per person double occupancy for cabin and air; add-ons priced per item; all-in totals include taxes and fees.
- Flight protection: Bundled airfare qualifies for line-protected rebooking to next port if flights are delayed.
- Booking window: 6–12 months recommended; peak-season bundled air allocates out 4–6 months ahead.
- Contact: quotes@sunsetsailtravel.example · +1-555-014-7788 · Tampa, FL. (https://www.sunsetsailtravel.example/#quote)
- Privacy: Quote data retained for 90 days. Request deletion at privacy@sunsetsailtravel.example.
